description: Implementation of ServerThread class for managing a QUIC server in test environment, including thread control, synchronization, and server event handling.

classes.name: ServerThread
classes.description: A thread class managing a QUIC server instance, handling initialization, event loop, synchronization, and shutdown.

methods.name: ServerThread::ServerThread
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server thread with a server instance and address.

methods.name: ServerThread::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the server by creating UDP socket and setting port.

methods.name: ServerThread::Run
methods.description: Main event loop executing server events and scheduled actions.

methods.name: ServerThread::Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a function to be executed in the server thread.

methods.name: ServerThread::WaitForCryptoHandshakeConfirmed
methods.description: Blocks until the handshake is confirmed.

methods.name: ServerThread::WaitUntil
methods.description: Waits until a predicate is true or timeout occurs.

methods.name: ServerThread::Resume
methods.description: Resumes the server thread if paused.

methods.name: ServerThread::Quit
